notes: Saving is safer: pressing Save locks that part of the page (⏳ Saving…) until it has saved, so you can’t get ahead of it – and if a save fails, your changes stay on the page
Changes you haven’t saved yet are never wiped by the page refreshing in the background (coming back to the window, ↻, or another save finishing); leaving the page asks first
Daily to-dos and reminders save faster
Diagnostics: the button says it’s working while the report is made
